version.changelog: Sync skill instructions, references, and helper from GitHub 4164b4f6c8272e152ee99cbafd3d88b4549533e3

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed, bounded football match analysis helper that fetches SofaScore data through Crawlora using a user-provided API key.

dimensions.detail: Network/API access and an API key are proportionate to retrieving match data; the script rejects POST/body options, restricts routes, and sends only query parameters for the documented endpoints.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install-time mutation, dependency installation, hooks, services, or background setup were found; metadata.json is empty and the artifact contains documentation plus one local helper script.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs agents to run a bundled shell helper for external GET requests, but the helper is constrained to a fixed Crawlora base URL and an allowlist of SofaScore routes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence or privilege escalation behavior was found; chmod 600 is used only to restrict a temporary curl config containing the API key, and the file is removed on exit.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is post-match football analysis, and the artifact consistently focuses on SofaScore event search, event detail, statistics, incidents, lineups, optional head-to-head/team events, and explicitly-labeled odds context.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending match search queries and event IDs to Crawlora/SofaScore using your CRAWLORA_API_KEY. Keep the key out of logs and shared transcripts, and ask the agent to limit broad or repeated match collection because those calls may consume API credits.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: The external Crawlora/SofaScore retrieval is not hidden in the artifact: SKILL.md tells agents to use scripts/crawlora.sh, and the endpoint reference documents the API base and x-api-key header.
[LP3] expected: The skill uses shell examples, but the bundled helper is narrowly coded for GET-only access to a fixed allowlist of SofaScore routes rather than arbitrary command execution.
[SDI-1] expected: The odds endpoint is disclosed in both SKILL.md and the endpoint reference, is optional, and is framed as a separate retrieved snapshot rather than betting advice or core match explanation.
[E1] expected: Outbound requests to https://api.crawlora.net/api/v1 are necessary for the skill's stated data-retrieval purpose and are documented; no unrelated destination or covert transmission was found.
[PE2] expected: The cited chmod 600 is not root execution or privilege escalation; it restricts permissions on a temporary curl config that contains the API key.
[SQP-2] expected: Credential use is disclosed through CRAWLORA_API_KEY and the helper takes reasonable care to avoid putting the key on the curl command line, though users should still keep the key private.
